title: Advanced Query Features
description: Transform data with PIVOT, join tables to functions with CROSS APPLY, use computed columns and sequences, and manage large datasets with partitioning.
whatYouLearn: How to use PIVOT to rotate rows into columns for crosstab reports
How CROSS APPLY joins a table to a table-valued function or correlated subquery
How computed columns and sequences provide reusable logic and auto-generated values
How table partitioning improves performance on large tables
How database snapshots provide point-in-time read-only views
